title: The port that only charges
request: Compare these two used monitors for my Luma L13 laptop. I need a single USB-C cable for both video and charging, total maximum 2,000 SEK including everything. I own no adapter.

evidence.text: Fictional Luma L13 supports DisplayPort Alt Mode video over USB-C and requires 45 W USB-C power delivery.
Fictional Vista V24C: its USB-C port supplies power only, not video. Video input requires HDMI. Its included cable supports charging only.
Fictional Vista V24D: USB-C supports DisplayPort Alt Mode video and up to 65 W power delivery; included exact cable supports both with Luma L13.
A V24C is 1,200.00 SEK delivered. B V24D is 1,800.00 SEK delivered. Both include their model-specified cables and power supplies with no other fees and are said to work. Both are active.

hard_failures.text: Recommends A as meeting the single-cable video-and-charging requirement merely because it has USB-C.

usefulness.text: Selects B at 1,800.00 SEK using the exact supplied compatibility evidence.
Distinguishes model-level capability from the used monitor's unverified condition.

acceptable_outcomes: B fits the supplied requirements on these documents; A needs a different connection arrangement and fails the single-cable constraint.
